reviews.text: Logan and his team have been maintaining my pool for the last six years. They do an excellent job and stay on top of all the chemicals so that we don’t get the algae That used to pop up in the spring. I highly recommend them for any pool cleaning or maintenance around the pool area. They do Excellent work!
reviews.author: josie spence

reviews.text: LB Pool Services did an excellent job rebuilding our pool. The team was professional, reliable, and easy to work with throughout the entire process. The quality of their work is outstanding, and the finished pool looks great. Everything was completed as promised, and we are very happy with the results. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Rene Karsholt

reviews.text: Always punctual and thorough. I trust Logan with all my pool needs. His honesty and integrity are obvious and I would recommend his company to everyone!
reviews.author: Ron Mills

reviews.text: My pool is in great shape and they keep it clean and running good.  When things need to be repaired or replaced, they do it quickly and affordably.  Always helpful when I have questions.
reviews.author: RACHEL SALES

reviews.text: Logan replastered and retiled our pool - we were so happy we went with him. He gets how to do business. He showed up the day after we called him to give us an estimate. He was honest & told us our coping was still in good shape. He responded immediately to all my questions. Then he under promised & way over delivered - he made this huge undertaking happen in just over a week for our guests! The pool looks great, and we love the new tile.
reviews.author: Allison Tirado

reviews.text: Easy to work with and great to work with! Prompt attention to all our needs while trying to sell our house. Referred to us by our realtors which is a hearty endorsement in itself. Couldn’t be happier!
reviews.author: Karen Hames

reviews.text: Used LB Pool Services to redo our tile and plaster. From the start Logan was very quick at getting back to us. Was able to squeeze us in for an estimate and got the quote back same day. The project started on a Tuesday morning and they were done and filling the pool by Friday. The crew were hard workers and very nice. One of them even moved our recycling can we had forgotten for us when he noticed the neighbors had theirs out. After they were done with the construction Logan came everyday for another week to prep the pool with chemicals and brushing it. We are very happy with the way it turned out. Throughout the entire process Logan would always keep us up to date and was always very quick in getting back to us. I highly recommend if looking for pool services.
reviews.author: Erin Head

reviews.text:
My pool pump gave out suddenly. Logan was able to get me worked into his schedule quickly, so I didn't end up with a green pool. Logan was able to get a pump that would work with my existing timer system and it's even quieter than the previous pump!

He did the work quickly: installed a new pump, did the plumbing, and even replaced some pool light bulb parts while he was at it.

I found him to be very knowledgeable and friendly. If you got a pool problem, give him a call.
reviews.author: Chase C
